sentences.text: Narambuenatitan is a lithostrotian titanosaur sauropod known from the incomplete holotype skeleton MAU-Pv-N-425.

Fossils were collected between 2005 and 2006 from the Anacleto Formation in northern Patagonia. The genus was first named by Leonardo S. Filippi, Rodolfo A. García, and Alberto C. Garrido in 2011. The generic name refers to the location Puesto Narambuena, while the specific name palomoi honors the discoverer Salvador Palomo.
Narambuenatitan belongs to the family Saltasauridae and is classified within the clade Lithostrotia, forming a trichotomy with Epachthosaurus and the clade Eutitanosauria.

The animal lived during the late Cretaceous, approximately 83.5 to 75 million years ago, in what is now South America. The time range for Narambuenatitan is estimated from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
